edition.contentSummary: Standalone film photobook featuring model/actor 이성경, photographs by 신혜림. Aladin corroborates release 2016-02-17, ISBN 9788997148615, 248 pages and 200×240mm; existing 16mm thickness remains attributed to YES24. Aladin lists 770g against older YES24 890g, retained as a source conflict rather than a canonical weight. New-copy list/displayed price KRW 22,000/19,800; distribution discontinued and unavailable. Twelve separately identified used offers were visible at KRW 13,900–32,900, with seller condition/shipping claims. Public cover and one publisher-provided promotional collage are linked remotely with attribution; no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.
